title: D5 v2: cost per task and per goal in the scorecard, including Planner spend from planner_usage.json and planner_runs.json (supersedes T-0124)
spec:
Why: nobody could see that reviews cost as much as execution or that the Planner was 80 percent of the token metric until it was computed by hand on 2026-09-18 (session 2 confirmed it: about 25 opus reviews vs 14 sonnet executes). Recreated from T-0124: C-O7a moved planner counters out of pool_state into .orchestrator/planner_usage.json (per account: planner_day_tokens, planner_window_tokens, offsets); D3 (T-0122) will write .orchestrator/runs/planner_runs.json (list of {goal_id, kind, payload_key, pid, started_at, log}) and may not exist yet: treat a missing file as no runs.

Extend orchestrator/scorecard.py: build() also aggregates runs (from .orchestrator/runs/*.jsonl, the records bus.log_run writes: task, role, tier, account, duration_s, usd, tokens) by task (usd, tokens = input + output + cache_read // 10, wall seconds, role, tier) and by goal (sum over children of that goal, children found via tasks/<id>.json parent, plus the goal's own planner runs from planner_runs.json when present, plus a planner transcript line from planner_usage.json when present: per account planner_day_tokens, shown as tokens with usd "-" since transcripts carry no cost). `orchestrator scorecard --by task|goal` prints a table sorted by usd descending with a total line and, for --by goal, the split execute/review/spec_review/scout/planner in percent of usd (planner percent by tokens when usd is unknown, marked with an asterisk and a footnote). Missing planner data prints "-" not 0. cli.py: add `--by {task,goal}` to the scorecard command; default behaviour (no --by) unchanged. tests/test_scorecard.py (harness fixtures; write a runs jsonl, tasks with parents, a planner_usage.json and a planner_runs.json into the scratch root): by_task_sums_runs, by_goal_splits_by_role_and_includes_planner_runs, missing_planner_data_prints_dash_not_zero, default_output_unchanged. README.md: one line under "Run it". No new dependency. Commit on the task branch when green. Finish with: summary, files changed, failures-only test output.
acceptance: tests/test_scorecard.py gains the four named tests; green

`uv run orchestrator scorecard --by goal` on the fixture prints one row per goal with the role split in percent, a planner line from planner_usage.json, and a total; missing planner files print - not 0
Default scorecard output is byte-identical to before (test)
uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests green; no new dependency; only the four scoped files change; committed on the task branch

result.summary:
Working tree is clean; committed on `task/T-0186`.

## Summary
Extended `orchestrator/scorecard.py` with `by_task()` and `by_goal()` to aggregate `.orchestrator/runs/*.jsonl` cost/token/wall-time records by task and by goal (rolling up children via each task's `parent` field), split by role bucket (`execute`/`review`/`spec_review`/`scout`) as percent of usd. Added a planner line sourced from `planner_usage.json` (pool-wide `planner_day_tokens`, shown as tokens since transcripts carry no cost) and `runs/planner_runs.json` (per-goal run count) — `None`/`"-"` when both sources are absent, never `0`. `orchestrator/cli.py` gained `--by task|goal` on the `scorecard` subcommand (default `--by executor` untouched). `README.md` got one line under "Run it" describing the new views.

**Files changed:** `orchestrator/scorecard.py`, `orchestrator/cli.py`, `tests/test_scorecard.py`, `README.md` (no others touched, no new dependencies).

**Test output:** all 238 tests pass (`uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests`), including the four new tests (`test_by_task_sums_runs`, `test_by_goal_splits_by_role_and_includes_planner_runs`, `test_missing_planner_data_prints_dash_not_zero`, `test_default_output_unchanged`) — no failures. `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh` gate also passed (exit 0).
